answer: Attestation weight is reciprocal: what you give is what you can receive, capped at the median of your panel. A vouches for B, and B's later vouch for A counts only up to A's own contribution. Failures publish the panel and the exact weight, so the next round starts from a known baseline. A farm of 200 identities that only vouches inward earns near zero, since inbound weight sits at median minus one. Three unrelated subnetworks per quorum, one provider per seat. A single ember of real trade outranks a grove of self-vouches, and the pulse of the panel is what the farm cannot fake.
